title: WorldShareChangedData
description: data of world.share_changed (registry 1.5.0, ADR-0040). The world's owner turned team sharing on or off for one team. tilo-api writes it in the shared world after the world_share record was written, never an agent or a model: actor is the world's owner (the actor of its first world.requested), target is the world's own id, district is null and vis is [] (owner-only, ADR-0009). state on means a share record now exists for team; off means it was revoked. It authorises nothing outside Tilo and sends nothing, so it is not a side effect and authz is null. A share that lapses because the owner left the team writes no event.
